# Generated API client - do not edit

Generated from `contracts/openapi/*.yaml` by `@hey-api/openapi-ts`.
Regenerate with `npm run gen:api` (from `mobile/`). Config: `openapi-ts.config.mjs`.
Change the contract, not these files. Hand edits are lost on the next run.

- `servicedesk/` from `servicedesk-api.yaml` (paths under `/api`)
- `notification/` from `notification-service.yaml` (paths under `/notify`)
